label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI, plus Uvation Pulse and Atlas CRM
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 19 items closed on 30 Sep, including product creation for all AI servers (MT-1485) and the home page redesign (MT-1524), both on their due date, the approved-quote email bug (MT-1539) and 11 RMA and email-template subtasks. The RMA backend (MT-1488) reached production. The full catalogue re-check (PC-136), also due 30 Sep, is still in progress. Four new bugs were raised, two on product import (MT-1559, MT-1560), plus smoke, security and privacy test stories. 17 open items are past due, down from 20.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: 30 Figma defects moved to UAT/staging for retest on 30 Sep, so 25 of 56 are fixed, 30 await retest and 1 is blocked (GDPR design, MR-1253). The sitemap fix (MR-1199) started the same day. The AI Factory P1 (MR-1260) is in progress with 2 of 15 subtasks fixed and one blocked (MR-1265). Nothing is past due; 10 bugs are open, none rated.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Ten items reached production on 30 Sep, including the S2 notification API failures (USP-4222) and the MSA signer and collaboration fixes. The three S1 production bugs from 25 and 28 Sep (wrong AI Factory prices and a Document API 502) are still in To Do on their 30 Sep due date, and the S1 Calculate Subscription 500 error (USP-4204) is in progress, also due today. 59 bugs are open, 5 of them S1, and 8 items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: No changes on 30 Sep. Book a Meeting and its five subtasks closed on 29 Sep, so nothing in the programme is past due. The CSM Teams dashboard (UC-215) is still in testing on its 30 Sep due date. Eight agent stories are still in To Do with no due dates.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: The only PULSE bug, the telemetry-ingest 401 (PULSE-329), closed on 30 Sep: the first done item on the board. The other 328 items (8 epics, 64 stories, 256 subtasks) are all held by Anshul Bhargava, 246 In Progress and 82 To Do, and none has a due date. Tempo shows 2.5 h in total (29 and 30 Sep), so the In Progress count does not reflect effort yet.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: No changes on 30 Sep. One story, ATLAS-1 'R&D on CRM for MVP', created 28 Sep and held by Anshul Bhargava, is still in To Do with no due date. 2.75 h is logged against it (2 h on 28 Sep, 45 min on 29 Sep).
